title: See through, or open it
hook: Which layout shows the orange item without opening boxes?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: that a clear box shows its contents only when its side is in view, a front label does the same job for an opaque box, and both fail when boxes are stacked out of sight

misconception: Clear boxes always beat labelled boxes for finding things.
objective: Under this ideal clear-front assumption, contents are visible from the shown viewpoint. Opaque boxes require another cue such as an address; transparency changes observation, not where the item is.
